set.body: Part of Epic bd-01KWVWM8ZP57V019JT646QA37N. Add contract/metamorphic/adversarial tests for the shared AR core: PACF/AR roundtrips across orders, stationarity clipping near boundaries, scale/sign invariants, zero/constant residual handling, short-segment estimation failure paths, and finite outputs under deterministic stress fixtures.
